title: N2 — THE CASCADE AND ITS STOP: derive the forced algebra sequence from N1 and prove it terminates
body:
FIRST: read docs/STANDARD.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, docs/ROADMAP.md (the N2 spec), docs/LEDGER.md. Follow your standing worker procedure (SOUL + the task SOP). 

CONTEXT FROM N1 (banked, commit ca3c2ab, Phys/Foundation/Fold.lean): the fold is DEFINED by the look-back law `IsFold look := ∀ x, look x + x = 0` on an additive group, and the following are PROVED foundations-only: fold_eq_neg (look x = -x, the unique annihilating reflection), fold_unique, fold_void (look 0 = 0), fold_involutive (look² = id — pointedly NOT -id), fold_self_blind (★ self-blindness: on a 2-torsion-free carrier, look x = x → x = 0). These are the trunk facts you DERIVE FROM. Do NOT re-derive N1; import and USE it (RUNBOOK W2).

TARGET (ROADMAP N2 — the crown node): DERIVE — not posit — the forced sequence of structures the fold generates, and prove it TERMINATES at a specific point. Each step is a theorem (structure k forces structure k+1); a theorem that the cascade HALTS at the terminal structure (the step that would continue is proved impossible / loses a required property). The field at large POSITS its starting algebra; here it must be DERIVED from N1 with the stop PROVED. This is the project's crown jewel (deriving what everyone posits).

DRIFT TRAP (critical): do NOT assume the terminal algebra and check properties backward — DERIVE the sequence FORWARD from N1 and let the stop be FORCED. Do NOT hardcode the number of steps. The stop must be a PROVED impossibility, not an asserted halt. THE ONE LAW: if any step "fights you," return to the trunk (fold, self-blindness, Born=self-overlap) — do NOT add a hypothesis to force the next rung, do NOT weaken the target to close it. The recursive self-blindness that forces a complex unit, then the doubling cascade, then its termination — each rung is a THEOREM, never an assertion.

WALL POLICY (RUNBOOK W1): if a rung is genuinely hard in Lean — (1) if Mathlib lacks the structure, BUILD it (do not panic); (2) reframe through the theory FIRST (it may dissolve when attacked from the fold); (3) still hard → enqueue a dedicated theory-native DISSOLUTION ticket as the IMMEDIATE NEXT node, block N2 on it. NEVER bridge/bypass/scope-reduce. N2 is large: DECOMPOSE early (RUNBOOK W3) — bank each rung as it closes, child for the remainder, keep the board single-flight (W4, strictly linear chain).

DONE = unbroken + complete (foundations-only, no sorry/axiom/native_decide/bridge) + physics-words-removable + gate green (scripts/gate.sh) + committed, then update docs/LEDGER.md and self-replenish N3 per ROADMAP. Each rung needs a costume that BITES (a wrong continuation AND a wrong stop must both fail to compile — ROADMAP N2).

title: N2b — CASCADE rungs ℍ, 𝕆 and the PROVED STOP: double again twice and prove termination
body:
FIRST: read docs/STANDARD.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, docs/ROADMAP.md (N2 spec), docs/LEDGER.md. Follow your standing worker procedure (SOUL + the task SOP).

CONTEXT — what is BANKED upstream (do NOT re-derive; import and USE — RUNBOOK W2):
- N1 (commit ca3c2ab, Phys/Foundation/Fold.lean): the fold `IsFold look := ∀ x, look x + x = 0`; foundations-only facts fold_eq_neg, fold_involutive (look²=id), fold_self_blind (self-blindness on 2-torsion-free carriers).
- N2 rung 1 (Phys/Cascade/ComplexUnit.lean, committed this run): IsFoldRoot J := IsFold (J∘J) — recursive self-blindness, rooted in N1. The OBSTRUCTION: positivity forbids a fold-root on the ordered line (sqrt_fold_not_on_line) AND on every odd dimension (★ foldRoot_forces_even_dim, the WHY-DOUBLE LAW: det(J)²=(−1)^dim≥0). The RESOLUTION: the forced complex algebra `Dbl R` (a CommRing over any CommRing R), with Dbl.J_mul_J (J*J=−1 DERIVED), Dbl.mul_forced (the Cayley–Dickson product is UNIQUELY forced by J²=−1 + bilinearity, via IsAdmissible), Dbl.J_self_blind (inherits N1 self-blindness). The cascade object is `Dbl R`; doubling it again is THIS node's job.

TARGET (ROADMAP N2, the crown — this node carries the remainder): continue the FORCED cascade by DOUBLING and prove the STOP.
  (1) Double `Dbl R` again → the quaternion algebra. Each structural property a THEOREM. The honest content: the next Cayley–Dickson double LOSES COMMUTATIVITY (prove it: exhibit non-commuting generators as a theorem; commutativity is not assertable-away, it genuinely fails). Still associative, still a division/normed structure.
  (2) Double again → the octonion algebra. LOSES ASSOCIATIVITY (prove non-associativity as a theorem: exhibit a non-associating triple). Still alternative / composition.
  (3) ★ THE PROVED STOP. Prove the cascade TERMINATES: the next doubling past the octonions LOSES the required property (the composition / Born = self-overlap norm law — ‖xy‖=‖x‖‖y‖ fails, equivalently zero divisors appear / it is no longer a division algebra). This is the "one cause, many terminations" template: the SAME octonionic non-associativity that appears at rung 3 is what BREAKS the law at the next step. The stop must be a PROVED IMPOSSIBILITY (a theorem that the would-be next structure loses the property), NOT an asserted halt and NOT a hardcoded step count.

DRIFT TRAP: DERIVE forward by the doubling operation (Cayley–Dickson on `Dbl`); do NOT import Mathlib's `Quaternion`/`Octonion` and point at them — that POSITS what we must DERIVE (a physicist READS ℍ/𝕆 out of the construction, never INTO it; mirror how rung 1 built `Dbl R` not `Complex`). Do NOT hardcode "stops at 3 doublings"; the stop is FORCED by the lost property. THE ONE LAW (W5): if a rung fights you, return to the trunk (fold, self-blindness, Born=self-overlap=positivity) — do NOT add a hypothesis to force a rung, do NOT weaken the target to close it.

WALL POLICY (W1): if a rung is genuinely hard in Lean — (a) if Mathlib lacks the structure, BUILD it (generalize the `Dbl` Cayley–Dickson double to carry a conjugation/norm; do not panic); (b) reframe through the theory FIRST; (c) still hard → enqueue a dedicated theory-native DISSOLUTION ticket as the IMMEDIATE NEXT node and block THIS node on it. NEVER bridge/bypass/scope-reduce. This node is LARGE: DECOMPOSE early (W3) — bank rung 2 (ℍ + non-commutativity) first, child for rung 3 (𝕆) + the STOP; keep the board STRICTLY single-flight (W4, one linear chain: before creating the next node, kanban_list and link onto the tail).

title: N2c — CASCADE rung 𝕆 (lose associativity) + THE PROVED STOP (composition/Born law dies past 𝕆)

FIRST: read docs/STANDARD.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, docs/ROADMAP.md (N2 spec), docs/LEDGER.md. Follow your standing worker procedure (SOUL + the task SOP).

CONTEXT — what is BANKED upstream (do NOT re-derive; import and USE — RUNBOOK W2):

- N2 rung 1 (Phys/Cascade/ComplexUnit.lean): IsFoldRoot J := IsFold (J∘J); the WHY-DOUBLE LAW foldRoot_forces_even_dim; the forced complex algebra Dbl R (a CommRing) with Dbl.J_mul_J (J²=−1 DERIVED) and Dbl.mul_forced.
- N2 rung 2 / THE DOUBLING OPERATION (Phys/Cascade/Double.lean, committed): the generic Cayley–Dickson double `CD A` of a `*`-ring — ONE operation reused at every rung. Banked: instance Ring (CD A) (associativity SURVIVES doubling a COMMUTATIVE associative `*`-ring — note the commutativity hypothesis), instance StarRing (CD A) (conjugation propagates so the cascade can iterate), CD.iota / CD.e2 / CD.iota_injective, and ★ CD.iota_e2_comm_iff (THE ONE CAUSE: ι a and e₂ commute IFF a = star a). Simp lemmas: CD.mul_re, CD.mul_im, CD.star_re, CD.star_im, etc.
- N2 rung 2 (Phys/Cascade/Quaternion.lean, committed): H R := CD (Dbl R) (doubling 2→4); Dbl made a StarRing (complex conjugation), Dbl.star_J (J*=−J), Dbl.J_ne_star_J (J≠J* when 2≠0 — the SAME 2-torsion condition the trunk rests on), H_associative (associativity PRESERVED), not_commutative / commutativity_cause / not_commutative_witness (DOUBLING LOSES COMMUTATIVITY, caused EXACTLY by the rung-1 unit J≠J* — one cause propagated one rung up), comm_products.

NUMERICS ALREADY BANKED (workbench/N2b-quaternion/FINDINGS.md + numerics.py, exact rational arithmetic — REUSE these structures, do NOT build a fresh table): the full cascade was probed. O = CD(H) at dim 8 is NON-associative (a non-associating triple exists) but STILL satisfies the composition/Born norm law N(xy)=N(x)N(y) and has no zero divisors. S = CD(O) at dim 16 LOSES the norm law (concrete witness 4064 ≠ 4160) and GAINS zero divisors (structured witness (e₁+e₁₀)(e₅+e₁₄)=0). The cause chain: O loses associativity BECAUSE H is non-commutative; S loses the norm law + gains zero divisors BECAUSE O is non-associative. These are the targets to PROVE in Lean.

TARGET (the remainder of ROADMAP N2 — the crown's tail):
  (1) RUNG 3: double again, O R := CD (H R) (doubling 4→8). Prove the honest content: doubling the NON-commutative associative ring LOSES ASSOCIATIVITY — exhibit a concrete non-associating triple as a THEOREM (e.g. (x*y)*z ≠ x*(y*z) for specific generators over ℚ). ★ THE ONE CAUSE: the non-associativity must be shown caused EXACTLY by the rung-2 non-commutativity (the same "one cause, propagated one rung up" template, mirroring commutativity_cause). NOTE: the banked `instance Ring (CD A)` REQUIRES `CommRing A`; H is NOT commutative, so O does NOT get a Ring instance from it — O is a non-associative algebra. You will likely need to give O its add-comm-group + distributive + the (non-associative) Mul directly, and PROVE the non-associativity theorem; do NOT force a Ring instance onto it (that would be false). Build the non-associative-algebra scaffolding if Mathlib lacks it (W1: BUILD it, do not panic).
  (2) ★ THE PROVED STOP (the terminal theorem of the whole cascade). Prove the cascade TERMINATES: the next double S R := CD (O R) (dim 8→16) LOSES the required property — the composition / Born = self-overlap norm law ‖xy‖=‖x‖‖y‖ FAILS, equivalently zero divisors appear / S is no longer a division algebra. PROVE it as an IMPOSSIBILITY THEOREM: either (a) exhibit a concrete zero divisor in S (two nonzero elements whose product is 0 — the FINDINGS give the witness (e₁+e₁₀)(e₅+e₁₄)=0 to translate into CD-coordinates), or (b) exhibit a concrete pair where N(xy) ≠ N(x)N(y). This is the "one cause, many terminations" capstone: the SAME octonionic non-associativity proved in (1) is what BREAKS the law at the next step — make that causal link a theorem if possible (the norm law on CD(A) holds iff A is associative-enough; show O fails the needed hypothesis). The stop is a PROVED loss, NOT an asserted halt and NOT a hardcoded step count.

THE ONE LAW (W5): if a rung fights you, return to the trunk (fold, self-blindness, Born=self-overlap=positivity) — do NOT add a hypothesis to force a rung, do NOT weaken the target to close it.

WALL POLICY (W1): if a rung is genuinely hard in Lean — (a) if Mathlib lacks the structure (non-associative algebra scaffolding, a norm/composition form on CD), BUILD it — generalize CD to carry a quadratic norm form N(z)=z·star z and prove its multiplicativity is equivalent to a base property; do not panic; (b) reframe through the theory FIRST — the stop may dissolve when you express the norm law as self-overlap (Born) and watch it break exactly where associativity broke; (c) still hard → enqueue a dedicated theory-native DISSOLUTION ticket as the IMMEDIATE NEXT node and block THIS node on it. - The defect tracks base non-association EXACTLY: 168 pure-unit biting witnesses in CD(𝕆) == 168 non-associating octonion triples (reframe2.py RESULT 3, probe.py).

FIRST (read every run, do NOT run on memory): docs/STANDARD.md (§1 completion bar; §2 word-removal; §3 number tower — ⚠ STANDING DEPENDENCY GATE: pure algebra/topology over the DERIVED ℝ/ℚ, NEVER `import Mathlib.Data.Real`/`Complex` as content; ⭐⭐ THIS NODE re-grounds on the DERIVED ℝ `ContinuumQ.Cut` + the terminal algebra `O Cut` + `STVC = Cut × Cut × O Cut` + the indefinite Minkowski form `BvC`/`QvC` + the operator topology `endOpC` (N152) + ⭐⭐ THE N157 NON-VACUOUS ENGINE `JoinedIdQvC` (`Phys/Algebra/LorentzContinuumGivensWordExhaustion.lean`): `JoinedIdQvC`, `joinedIdQvC_one`/`joinedIdQvC_mul`/`joinedIdQvC_listProd` (WORD-INDUCTION) + `joinedIdQvC_isQvIsomC` (THE NON-VACUITY) + ⭐⭐ THE N161 GENERAL BIREFLECTION LIFT + WORD (`Phys/Algebra/LorentzContinuumOctBlockSO8ClosureWord.lean`): `houseHolder_smul` (scale-invariance), `normalize_unit`, `bireflection_eq_octPlaneRot_gen` (the GENERAL two-axis identity), `joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_octPlaneRot_circle` (unconditional circle-point lift incl the antipode), ⭐⭐ `joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflection` (THE CORE — the lifted GENERAL bireflection of ANY two nonzero-Born-norm vectors is JoinedIdQvC, orthonormality REMOVED), ⭐⭐ `joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflectionWord` (THE WORD — any finite product of general bireflections lifts to JoinedIdQvC) + ⭐⭐ THE N124 REFLECTION WORD (`gFormC_isom_mem_closure`: every gFormC-isometry of `O Cut` is a finite product of Householder reflections `Submonoid.closure houseHolderSet`) + the banked `houseHolder`/`houseHolder_apply`/`houseHolder_involutive`/`houseHolder_isom`/`houseHolder_fixes_ortho`/`houseHolder_neg_self` (N124) + `octReflBlock` (N121) + the lift `octBlockEndC`/`octBlockEndC_mul`/`octBlockEndC_one`/`octBlockEndC_isBvIsomLin` (N129/N160) + the core peel `joinedIdQvC_of_timeFixing_evCOrth_peel` (N158).

⭐⭐ CRITICAL CONTEXT — WHAT N161 BANKED AND WHY THIS NODE IS THE SINGLE RESIDUAL. N161 (11 decls, gate D0–D6 GREEN, costume C193 1=161) banked the GENERAL bireflection lift (`joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflection`: the lifted bireflection `octBlockEndC (houseHolder a · houseHolder b)` of ANY two nonzero-Born-norm vectors is JoinedIdQvC, N160's orthonormality REMOVED via Gram–Schmidt + the trunk Born positivity gFormC_nonneg, NO Cauchy–Schwarz) and the bireflection WORD (`joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflectionWord`: any finite product `(L.map (fun t => houseHolder t.1 * houseHolder t.2)).prod` of general bireflections lifts to JoinedIdQvC). So the SINGLE residual: N124's `gFormC_isom_mem_closure` gives membership in `Submonoid.closure houseHolderSet` — a FLAT reflection word of UNKNOWN length parity; this node must show every det +1 (SO(8)) isometry is an EVEN reflection word, then RE-PAIR that even word two-at-a-time into a `List (O Cut × O Cut)` of bireflections feeding `joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflectionWord`. The compact factor we peel (N158) lands in the det +1 / SO part, so the word IS even — but Lean needs the parity TRACKED.

⭐ THE TARGET (N162). FIRST ACT (REQUIRED): RE-READ the ROADMAP §N162 FORWARD FRONTIER paragraph (tail) and SPECIFY the exact node against what the chain ACTUALLY produced. Priority order:
  (i) ⭐ THE DET-PARITY CLOSURE BRIDGE — the residual is the `det : O(8) → {±1}` ℤ/2 homomorphism (each `houseHolder` ↦ −1, the `SO` part ↦ +1) to track word-length parity over the `Submonoid.closure_induction`, OR an equivalent parity accumulator. ⚠ MEASURE FIRST (W1/W9) the SMALLEST obligation: (a) Mathlib lacks a `det`/spinor-norm `O(n) → {±1}` over the derived `Cut` — probe whether `LinearMap.det`/`LinearEquiv.det` over `O Cut` (finrank 8, N122) is usable, each `houseHolder` having det −1; OR (b) whether the closure induction can carry the parity as an auxiliary `Bool`/`ZMod 2` accumulator paired with the bireflection list directly (a `Submonoid.closure_induction` building BOTH a reflection-count parity AND a bireflection-pair list); OR (c) whether a Clifford spinor-norm parity is the lighter route. Compute which is lightest BEFORE committing. ⚠ THE GENERAL BIREFLECTION IS BANKED (N161) — do NOT re-derive it; the residual is ONLY the even-word pairing + parity bookkeeping.
  OR (lateral / independent W1 fronts, MEASURE which the chain ACTUALLY opens next):
  (ii) THE FULL G₂ toward 14-dim via the heavy `expOEquiv` route (`Der(O) = g₂` dim-14 banked N20, the exponential to the GROUP open).
  (iii) the abstract identification of `kleinFour` (N141) with a Mathlib Klein-four object — ⚠ W4.5: MEASURE whether this OPENS new structure vs re-confirms N141's concrete table (a bare MulEquiv re-label is a lateral re-pin; child as OPTIONAL).

⭐ THE W1 REFRAME + MEASURE FIRST (W1/W9). MEASURE FIRST — probe the SMALLEST obligation before committing. REFRAME THROUGH THE TRUNK FIRST — the general bireflection lift + word IS BANKED (N161); the residual is the even-word pairing + det-parity bookkeeping, NOT a fresh exhaustion and NOT a re-derivation of the bireflection. If it genuinely RESISTS after measure + reframe, DECOMPOSE (bank the det/parity homomorphism `det : O(8) → {±1}` separately; child the parity-tracked closure induction) — an HONEST W1 dissolution ticket + block, NOT a grind. Failure / silent-scope-reduction NOT on the menu. ⚠ THE ONE LAW (W5): if the parity bookkeeping fights you, you are likely drifting — return to the trunk; the engines (N121 octReflBlock, N122 finrank=8, N123 skeleton, N124 reflection oracle/word, N157 JoinedIdQvC engine, N158 core peel, N159 octPlaneRot generator + word, N160 even-pair = half-turn core, N161 GENERAL bireflection lift + word) ARE banked, the residual is the det-parity closure induction to a bireflection list, NOT a posited connectedness/determinant. ⚠ DO NOT regress to the vacuous `JoinedIdC` — the target is the NON-VACUOUS `JoinedIdQvC` (N157); a result phrased in `JoinedIdC` is vacuous (joinedIdC_everything) and does NOT count.

⭐⭐ ANTI-TIMEOUT (W9 — max runtime 2700s/45min, ITERATION budget ~90): checkpoint EARLY (~50% turns/iterations), FINALIZE (commit + gate-bg + child + complete) with turns AND iterations to spare. BANK-AS-YOU-GO: the instant a lemma compiles clean, MOVE to production (new file under Phys/Algebra/, e.g. `LorentzContinuumOctBlockSO8DetParity.lean` or whatever the measured node names) + wire (Phys.lean + Audits/AxiomAudit.lean import block AT THE END OF THE IMPORT LIST — the last import is currently `import Phys.Algebra.LorentzContinuumOctBlockSO8ClosureWord` — + #print axioms lines) + commit BEFORE chasing the full theorem. ⚠⚠ DOUBLE-CHECK THE AxiomAudit IMPORT: when you add #print axioms lines, ALSO add the matching `import Phys.Algebra.<NewFile>`. AxiomAudit.lean is at the REPO ROOT `Audits/AxiomAudit.lean` (NOT under Phys/). ⚠⚠ CHECK FOR NAME COLLISIONS before finalizing (grep `def <name>`/`theorem <name>` across Phys/ Counterexamples/ Audits/ Phys.lean for every new decl name). ⚠ THE PROBE PREAMBLE: a standalone probe importing the tail file MUST include `attribute [local instance] CD.narCD CD.srCD` and `attribute [local instance] Phys.Algebra.dblModuleCut` after the opens. ⚠ THE OPERATOR TOPOLOGY: `endOpC` is an `instance` in N152's file — a probe/production file importing it (transitively) gets it automatically. ⚠ D2 GATE: do NOT write the literal token "native_decide" anywhere in a production/costume file (even in a block comment — D2 greps the bare word); write "native-kernel-bypass" instead. ⭐⭐ AND THE INSTANT production + gate are committed, IMMEDIATELY child the next node + kanban_complete. Run the GATE in BACKGROUND (terminal background=true, notify_on_complete=true; poll its log file, do NOT block your turn budget on D5/D6 — the costume battery + D6 audit take ~10–15min). ⭐ ON RETRY, CHECK INHERITED WIP FIRST (W6 verify-then-finalize): git log + git status + existing oleans (.lake/build/lib/lean/Phys/Algebra/, Lean 4.29) + the prior thread/heartbeats. A production file that BUILT with all wiring + costume + docs + a committed GREEN gate log is a prior run that timed out BEFORE childing+completing — W6 VERIFY-THEN-FINALIZE (re-audit axioms, re-run costume bite, confirm gate log committed), then child + complete — NOT a rebuild. ⚠ A production file with a BUILT olean but UNCOMMITTED (git status ?? / M) is the W9.8 "work done, never banked" failure (run 367's exact failure on N161) — VERIFY (axioms vs olean + costume bite + wiring + manifest row) then COMMIT + child + complete, NOT a rebuild. ⚠ ALSO CLEAN UP any empty/scratch probe files left in Phys/ or the repo root (mv to workbench/, deletion triggers the mass-file-deletion guard). INFLATED maxHeartbeats / monolithic brute = W9 crime scene.

⚠ W8 — anti-vacuity. The new costume (next id C194) MUST bite a WRONG det-parity / even-word / closure-bireflection / JoinedIdQvC / G₂ / Klein-four claim. The WRONG claim MUST fail to compile, reducing to a false numeric DISTINCT from the banked battery (… C192 1=160, C193 1=161 — use 1=162 or another DISTINCT value). PASS_SIGNATURE is an ERE — use `.` for special chars, escape `*` as `.*`, avoid a leading `-`; AND make the false numeric DISTINCT from every banked value incl C193 1=161. Reuse banked objects. ⚠ ANTI-VACUITY ESPECIALLY: DOUBLE-CHECK the new result is NON-vacuous (the costume bites; the result is phrased in JoinedIdQvC not JoinedIdC; deleting physics words leaves a real constraint, not "the vector space is connected").

⭐ DISCIPLINE. PREREG workbench/N162-.../ (frozen GO/NO-GO + KILL before compute; KILL classifies a fight as INSTRUMENT failure not theory). Scratch lean isolated (cp into workbench/<probe>.lean, `lake env lean`, grep full errors, MOVE probes out of Phys/ AND the repo root before finalizing — mv to workbench/, do NOT bulk-rm). Production lean in Phys/ (zero axioms; VERIFY #print axioms ⊆ {propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound} yourself against the built olean + register in Audits/AxiomAudit.lean WITH ITS IMPORT AND add to Phys.lean). Costume = ONE ROW in scripts/costume_manifest.tsv (next id C194). Gate scripts/gate.sh (bg) — D3 greps LITERAL 'at-grade'/'asserted at grade'/'named bridge' (NOT the bare word 'bridge') scoped to Phys/ Counterexamples/ Audits/ Phys.lean ONLY; write 'a fully proved implication'/'without a proof'. STANDARD check (unbroken/complete/words-removable). Commit + LEDGER row + ROADMAP (N162 LANDED or DECOMPOSED, specify the NEXT node). Gate-green NECESSARY≠SUFFICIENT.

DONE = the chosen N162 front PROVED — DERIVED from the chain (the banked N49–N161 + the derived ℝ ContinuumQ.Cut + the terminal algebra O Cut + STVC + BvC/QvC + the operator topology endOpC + the NON-VACUOUS engine JoinedIdQvC/joinedIdQvC_mul/joinedIdQvC_listProd N157 + the GENERAL bireflection lift + word joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflection/joinedIdQvC_octBlockEndC_bireflectionWord N161 + the octonion-block generator octPlaneRot + the even-pair = half-turn core houseHolder_bireflection_eq_octPlaneRot/octBlockEndC_mul N160 + the lift octBlockEndC/octBlockEndC_isBvIsomLin N129 + the core peel joinedIdQvC_of_timeFixing_evCOrth_peel N158 + the reflection word gFormC_isom_mem_closure/houseHolder/houseHolder_involutive/houseHolder_isom N124 + octReflBlock N121 + the recursion skeleton reflection_exhaustion N123 + the finrank tower finrank_O_eq_eight_Cut=8 N122 + Der(O)=g₂ N20), gate D0–D6 green, costume C194 bites a WRONG det-parity / even-word / closure-bireflection / JoinedIdQvC / G₂ / Klein-four claim, foundations-only, NON-VACUOUS (phrased in JoinedIdQvC not the vacuous JoinedIdC), committed + LEDGER + ROADMAP updated, STANDARD applied; the NEXT node childed onto the chain tail. OR a DECOMPOSITION (bank the immediately-bankable structural piece — e.g. the det : O(8) → {±1} homomorphism; child the parity-tracked closure induction). OR an honest W1 dissolution ticket + block if the chosen front resists after measure + reframe. NO posited Lorentz group, NO posited Pin/Spin group, NO posited Clifford structure, NO posited gauge group, NO posited G₂, NO posited automorphism group, NO posited cover homomorphism, NO posited topology, NO posited connectedness, NO posited path-connectedness, NO posited determinant/parity homomorphism, NO posited rotation flow/angle, NO posited KAK product, NO posited compact group, NO posited SO(9)/SO(8) exhaustion, NO regression to the VACUOUS JoinedIdC, NO Mathlib ℝ/ℂ as content, NO bridge.

⭐⭐ CRITICAL CONTEXT — WHAT N171 BANKED AND WHAT THIS NODE CLOSES. PRIOR BANKED: N170 ⭐⭐ `joinedIdQvC_of_timeFixing_SO9` (a time-fixing QvC-isometry whose x-axis MOVES `(k(0,1,0)).2.2≠0` and whose deflated stabilizer `deflateNinth x' v'·k` has octonion-v-block det=1 is JoinedIdQvC, EvC-free); N169 ⭐⭐ `qvIsom_orthochronous_boost_factor` (`p = B·k`, B = genBoostLin read off p e₀, k a time-fixing QvC-isometry k e₀=e₀) + ⭐⭐ `joinedIdQvC_of_timeFixing_residual` (IF k is JoinedIdQvC THEN orthochronous p is); N163 ⭐⭐ `joinedIdQvC_of_xtFixing_det_one` (a det-+1 QvC-isometry fixing BOTH axes is JoinedIdQvC — the x-FIXING / antipode-adjacent case). KEY MATHLIB LEVER MEASURED-AVAILABLE: `LinearMap.det_conj` (conjugating a linear map by a `LinearEquiv` preserves det — the route to reduce det_genBoostLin / det_deflateNinth from a NON-coordinate 2-plane axis to a coordinate-plane det).

⭐ THE TARGET (N172). FIRST ACT (REQUIRED): RE-READ the ROADMAP §N172 FORWARD FRONTIER paragraph and SPECIFY the exact node. The UNCONDITIONAL full SO⁺(1,9) closure now needs the DET-OF-BOOST / DET-OF-DEFLATION / ANTIPODE / FINAL det-multiplicativity ASSEMBLY:
  (a) ⭐ `det_genBoostLin = 1` — the general-axis boost `genBoostLin wx wv a b` is a 2-plane t–ŵ transformation with a NON-coordinate axis ŵ=(wx,wv). ⚠ MEASURE FIRST (W1/W9): reduce via `det_conj` to a coordinate-plane boost (`det_boostFin`, banked), OR an adapted-frame block split; do NOT expand the 10×10 (the W9 trap). REFRAME THROUGH THE TRUNK FIRST — `genBoostLin` is an EXPLICIT derived operator (genBoostLin_eq_boostEndC at ŵ=(1,0); genBoostLin_isQvIsomC; genBoostLin_comp_inv the group structure).
  (b) ⭐ `det_deflateNinth = 1` — `deflateNinth x' v' = axisRotLin (r⁻¹•v') x' (−r)`, the same 2-plane x–ê rotation shape; a rotation has det = +1 (the product of two reflections, mirroring N162's `det_houseHolderWord` parity, OR `det_conj` to a coordinate-plane rotation). ⭐⭐ CRITICAL CONTEXT — WHAT N190 BANKED. The COMPLETION of the isospin branching of the 7. N189 split off the singlet ℚ·e₄ (e₄ = κO 1 = ⟨0,1⟩); N190 (`Phys/Algebra/DerivationRep7FullBranching.lean`, namespace `Phys.Algebra`, 20 decls, gate D0–D6 GREEN expected, costume C222 `3 = 190`, foundations-only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) banked the FULL 7 = 1 ⊕ 3 ⊕ 3 decomposition of ImO (N22) under the embedded su(2). The octonion rung O ℚ = CD(H ℚ) = ⟨H,H⟩ has TWO complementary coordinate embeddings of the quaternion rung: the OLD line `iotaO : H ℚ →ₗ[ℚ] O ℚ`, `a↦⟨a,0⟩` (`iotaO_apply`, `iotaO_injective`) and the NEW plane `kappaO` (N189). The inner derivations act componentwise (N6), so BOTH copies carry the adjoint action: ⭐ `innerDeriv_iotaO` (`innerDeriv q (iotaO a) = iotaO (adHom q a)`) and ⭐ `innerDeriv_kappaO_full` (`innerDeriv q (kappaO b) = kappaO (adHom q b)`) — generalizing N189's e₄ special case. The imaginary quaternion subspace `ImH := ker(starLH+1)` (`starLH`/`starLH_apply`, `mem_ImH`) has ⭐⭐ `finrank_ImH_eq_three` (rank–nullity: `range_starLH_add_one`=ℚ·1, `reH`/`reH_trace`, `one_ne_zero_H`, `finrank_H_eq_four` N19). Then ImO (finrank 7, N22) is the internal sup of THREE su(2)-invariant pieces: ⭐⭐ `fullBranching_sup_eq_ImO` (`Submodule.map iotaO ImH ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ {κO 1} ⊔ Submodule.map kappaO ImH = ImO`), each invariant — `adHom_mem_ImH` (adHom q preserves ImH for imaginary q, via banked `adHom_star_comm`), `invariant_iotaImH`, `invariant_kappaImH` (the singlet B fixed by N189); dimensions `finrank_iotaImH`=3, `finrank_singletLine`=1, `finrank_kappaImH`=3, ⭐⭐ `branching_dim_sum` (3+1+3 = finrank ImO = 7). W8 `action_on_iotaImH_ne_zero` (innerDeriv hI (iotaO hJ) ≠ 0, adHom hI hJ=2hK≠0 — the su(2) acts nontrivially on the OLD adjoint 3). THE BRANCHING IS COMPLETE: 7 = 1 ⊕ 3 ⊕ 3.

⚠⚠ THE STATE OF THE GAUGE STRUCTURE. The three SM gauge factors are banked INDIVIDUALLY (colour SU(3)⊂G₂=Der(O) dim 14 N42/N20, isospin SU(2)=Der(H) bracket N184 + dim 3 N185, hypercharge U(1)=so(2) dim 1 N186); the rung-inclusion tower u(1)↪su(2)↪g₂ is COMPLETE (N187 upper, N188 lower); the isospin branching of the 7 is COMPLETE (N189 singlet + N190 full 1⊕3⊕3). ⚠ W4.5 SUFFICIENCY: do NOT re-pin any factor, do NOT re-state either rung of the tower, do NOT re-derive the branching by another invariant, do NOT re-state the 1⊕3⊕3 in another guise. The honest NEW content is the NEXT relation or a new structure.

⭐ THE TARGET (N191). FIRST ACT (REQUIRED): RE-READ the ROADMAP §N190-superseded FORWARD FRONTIER paragraph and SPECIFY the exact node against what the chain ACTUALLY produced. ⚠⚠ ALWAYS grep/inspect what is ALREADY banked before picking a front (W4.5 — the centralizer fronts touch `derivation` N6/N187, `DerivationStabilizer*.lean` N42a/b/c (the colour su(3) stabilizer of a fixed unit u1=e₁ + the 7=3⊕3̄⊕1 colour branching), `DerivationRep7.lean`/`DerivationRep7FullBranching.lean` N22/N190 (ImO, ImH, the 1⊕3⊕3), `DerivationIrreducible*.lean` N25/N26/N27; inspect these BEFORE choosing a front). The independent W1 fronts (MEASURE the smallest obligation of each BEFORE committing — W9 measure-first):
  (i) ⭐ the CENTRALIZER / NORMALIZER of the embedded su(2)=⟨innerDeriv hI/J/K⟩ (N187) inside g₂=Der(O ℚ) — the commutant in the banked `derivation` (N6); MEASURE whether it opens the colour–isospin commutant su(3)↔su(2) relation, a genuine NEW g₂-subalgebra structure. ⚠ NOTE the type split: innerDeriv hX lives in `derivation` (N6, over ℤ, Module.End ℤ), while N42's stabilizer lives in `derivationLieQ` (N20/N42, over ℚ, Module.End ℚ) — MEASURE whether the centralizer is naturally posed in one or needs a bridge between them (likely the ℚ-linear derivationLieQ is the right home; check IsDerivQ/derivLieQ machinery). ⚠ A centralizer that is trivially the whole algebra (or trivially zero / abelian) is VACUOUS — reject (W8). MEASURE the actual commutant dimension first.
  (ii) ⭐ the FULL SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1) product / commuting-subalgebra structure assembling the three factors inside a single derivation algebra — is there a PROVED direct-sum / commuting-subalgebra structure? MEASURE whether it opens NEW structure or merely juxtaposes the three banked factors (reject).
  (iii) ⭐ hypercharge normalization / the electroweak U(1) embedding / a Yang–Mills structure / a different unbanked physics joint entirely (W4.5: look WIDE).
  ⚠⚠ If a front measures as heavy/re-pin/vacuous/a juxtaposition, look WIDER. Do NOT force a re-pin or restatement just to land a node (W4.5). A too-easy/vacuous/juxtaposition node is a BUG (W8).

⭐⭐ ANTI-TIMEOUT (W9 — max runtime per run): checkpoint EARLY, FINALIZE (commit + gate-bg + child + complete) with turns AND iterations to spare. BANK-AS-YOU-GO: the instant a lemma compiles clean, MOVE to production + wire (Phys.lean + Audits/AxiomAudit.lean import AT THE END OF THE IMPORT LIST + #print axioms lines AT THE END) + commit BEFORE chasing the full theorem. ⚠⚠ DOUBLE-CHECK THE AxiomAudit IMPORT (repo root `Audits/AxiomAudit.lean`). ⚠⚠ CHECK FOR NAME COLLISIONS before finalizing (grep `def <name>`/`theorem <name>` across Phys/ Counterexamples/ Audits/ Phys.lean — from N190: iotaO/iotaO_apply/iotaO_injective/kappaO_injective/innerDeriv_iotaO/innerDeriv_kappaO_full/starLH/starLH_apply/ImH/mem_ImH/reH/reH_trace/one_ne_zero_H/range_starLH_add_one/finrank_ImH_eq_three/adHom_mem_ImH/invariant_iotaImH/invariant_kappaImH/fullBranching_sup_eq_ImO/finrank_iotaImH/finrank_kappaImH/finrank_singletLine/branching_dim_sum/action_on_iotaImH_ne_zero; from N189: kappaO/kappaO_apply/kappaO_one_mem_ImO/kappaO_one_ne_zero/innerDeriv_kappaO_one/singlet_fixed_by_isospin/kappaO_one_coord/g2_moves_singletLine/isospin_singlet_ne_zero; from N187: liftEnd_*, adHom_comp_comm, innerDeriv_bracket, hI/hJ/hK_imag, innerDeriv_hI/J/K_isDerivO/_mem/_ne_zero, struct_ij/jk/ki; from N6: adHom/innerDeriv/liftEnd/IsDeriv/derivation/innerDeriv_apply/adHom_apply/adHom_star_comm; from N22: ImO/imRep/starL/mem_ImO/finrank_ImO; from N25: no_one_dim_invariant_ImO/IsDerivQ; from N42a/b: stabLieQ/evalU1/finrank_stabLieQ; from N20: derivationLieQ). ⚠ A structure node likely needs `import Phys.Algebra.DerivationRep7FullBranching` (N190) + `DerivationHIntoO` (N187) + `DerivationIrreducible` (N25) + possibly `DerivationStabilizer*` and the `attribute [local instance] CD.narCD CD.srCD` preamble. ⚠ D2 GATE: do NOT write the literal token "native_decide" anywhere (even in a comment); write "native-kernel-bypass". ⚠ D3 GATE greps LITERAL 'at-grade'/'asserted at grade'/'named bridge'/'smuggl' (NOT the bare word 'bridge') scoped to Phys/ Counterexamples/ Audits/ Phys.lean ONLY; write 'a fully proved implication'/'without a proof'. ⭐⭐ AND THE INSTANT production + gate are committed, IMMEDIATELY child the next node + kanban_complete. Run the GATE in BACKGROUND (terminal background=true, notify_on_complete=true; poll its log file with SHORT bounded reads, do NOT block your turn budget on D5/D6 — costume battery + D6 audit take ~10–15min). ⭐ ON RETRY, CHECK INHERITED WIP FIRST (W6 verify-then-finalize): git log + git status + existing oleans (.lake/build/lib/lean/, Lean 4.29) + the prior thread/heartbeats. A production file that BUILT with all wiring + costume + docs + a committed GREEN gate log is a prior run that timed out BEFORE childing+completing — W6 VERIFY-THEN-FINALIZE (re-audit axioms vs the built olean, re-run costume bite, confirm gate log committed), then child + complete — NOT a rebuild. INFLATED maxHeartbeats / monolithic brute = W9 crime scene. ALSO CLEAN UP any scratch probe files left in Phys/ or the repo root (mv to workbench/).

⚠ W8 — anti-vacuity. The new costume (next id C223) MUST bite a WRONG claim of the chosen front, reducing to a false numeric DISTINCT from the banked battery (… C220 2=188, C221 1=189, C222 3=190 — use a DISTINCT value, e.g. some_value=191). PASS_SIGNATURE is an ERE — use `.` for special chars, escape `*` as `.*`, avoid a leading `-`. ⚠ ANTI-VACUITY ESPECIALLY for a STRUCTURE/CONNECTION node: the relation must be NON-trivial — a map identically zero / an inclusion that is vacuous / a centralizer that is the whole algebra (or trivially zero) / a "juxtaposition" that proves nothing new must be REJECTED (W8 + W4.5). The costume must bite the GENUINE relational/structural content, not a re-statement of an already-banked fact.

Physics-words-removable: delete every physics word (colour/isospin/hypercharge/SM/gauge/SU(3)/SU(2)/U(1)/electroweak/singlet/adjoint/branching/rep/commutant/centralizer) → the statement must stand as pure math about the banked objects + the derived ℚ/ℝ Cut + the Cayley–Dickson tower Dbl ℚ ⊂ H ℚ ⊂ O ℚ + the derivation/skew-rotation algebras + the inner-derivation engine adHom/innerDeriv/liftEnd (N6) + the inclusion tower (N187/N188) + the full branching (N189/N190) + the Lie bracket.

⭐ DISCIPLINE. PREREG workbench/N191-.../ (frozen GO/NO-GO + KILL before compute). Scratch lean isolated (cp into a temp file, `lake env lean` — note: `lake env lean` does NOT emit an olean, so to axiom-audit either build the module via `lake build <Module>` OR append `#print axioms` lines to the probe and read stdout; MOVE probes out of Phys/ AND the repo root before finalizing — mv to workbench/, do NOT bulk-rm). Production lean in Phys/ (zero axioms; VERIFY #print axioms ⊆ {propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound} yourself against the built olean + register in Audits/AxiomAudit.lean WITH ITS IMPORT AND add to Phys.lean). Costume = ONE ROW in scripts/costume_manifest.tsv (next id C223), TAB-separated (BID<TAB>file<TAB>signature). Gate scripts/gate.sh (bg). STANDARD check (unbroken/complete/words-removable). Commit + LEDGER row + ROADMAP (N191 LANDED or DECOMPOSED, specify the NEXT node). Gate-green NECESSARY≠SUFFICIENT.

DONE = the chosen N191 front PROVED — DERIVED from the chain (the banked N49–N190 + the derived ℚ/ℝ Cut + the Cayley–Dickson tower + the three gauge-algebra factors + the COMPLETE inclusion tower u(1)↪su(2)↪g₂ N187/N188 + the COMPLETE branching of the 7 N189/N190 + the inner-derivation engine adHom/innerDeriv/liftEnd N6 + the g₂-irreducibility levers N22/N25), gate D0–D6 green, costume C223 bites a WRONG claim, foundations-only, NON-VACUOUS (a genuine relation/structure, not a juxtaposition or re-pin), committed + LEDGER + ROADMAP updated, STANDARD applied; the NEXT node childed onto the chain tail. OR a DECOMPOSITION (bank the bankable structural piece now; child the remainder). OR an honest W1 dissolution ticket + block if the chosen front resists after measure + reframe. NO posited su(2)/so(3)/su(3)/u(1)/SU(2)/SU(3)/U(1)/Lie group as content, NO Mathlib ℝ/ℂ as content, NO bridge.

NOTE on max_retries: this node should carry max_retries=25 (the hard analytic/proof nodes routinely need 5–15 runs via bank-as-you-go; the default breaker trips at the 2nd timeout). If the creating tool could not set it, the operator should set it on the board.

title: N192 — THE NEXT FRONTIER beyond the now-banked so(4) = su(2)_S × su(2)_T ⊂ g₂ = Der(O ℚ) (N191: the embedded weak-isospin su(2)=⟨innerDeriv hI/J/K⟩ N187 is the DIAGONAL of TWO MUTUALLY COMMUTING su(2)'s — the second-slot family leftImDeriv Q:⟨a,b⟩↦⟨0,Q·b⟩ closes [leftImDeriv Q,leftImDeriv Q']=leftImDeriv(Q·Q'−Q'·Q) and the difference family secondSU2 P:=innerDeriv P−leftImDeriv P closes secondSU2(P·P'−P'·P), with secondSU2_commutes_leftImDeriv ⁅secondSU2 P,leftImDeriv Q⁆=0 and innerDeriv_eq_diagonal innerDeriv P=secondSU2 P+leftImDeriv P; W8 both factors nonzero + diagonal_not_commute_leftImDeriv; foundations-only): the next genuinely-unbanked structure the chain opens (W4.5 look WIDE) — MEASURE the smallest obligation of each front BEFORE committing (W9)

N191 OPENED that diagonal into the full so(4) = su(2)_S × su(2)_T of two MUTUALLY COMMUTING su(2)'s:
  • ⭐ `leftImDeriv Q : O ℚ → O ℚ`, `⟨a,b⟩ ↦ ⟨0, Q·b⟩` (the SECOND-SLOT family, `leftImDeriv_apply`), a Leibniz-derivation for imaginary Q (`leftImDeriv_isDeriv`, re-defect cancels via star Q=−Q + base associativity, im by distributivity — NO associator).
  • ⭐ `leftImDeriv_bracket`: ⁅leftImDeriv Q, leftImDeriv Q'⁆ = leftImDeriv (Q·Q' − Q'·Q) [su(2)_T closes].
  • ⭐ `innerDeriv_leftImDeriv_bracket`: ⁅innerDeriv P, leftImDeriv Q⁆ = leftImDeriv (P·Q − Q·P) [cross]; + `leftImDeriv_innerDeriv_bracket` (swapped).
  • ⭐ `secondSU2 P := innerDeriv P − leftImDeriv P` (the DIFFERENCE family, `secondSU2_isDeriv`); ⭐⭐ `secondSU2_bracket`: ⁅secondSU2 P, secondSU2 P'⁆ = secondSU2 (P·P' − P'·P) [su(2)_S closes].
  • ⭐⭐ `secondSU2_commutes_leftImDeriv`: ⁅secondSU2 P, leftImDeriv Q⁆ = 0 [su(2)_S ⊥ su(2)_T = so(4)].
  • ⭐⭐ `innerDeriv_eq_diagonal`: innerDeriv P = secondSU2 P + leftImDeriv P [the embedded isospin IS the diagonal].
  • At the cascade rungs (B := Dbl ℚ): membership in `derivation (B := Dbl ℚ) = Der(O ℚ)` (`leftImDeriv_hI/J/K_mem`, `secondSU2_hI/J/K_mem`); both factors carry the su(2)≅so(3) structure constants (`leftImDeriv_struct_ij/jk/ki`, `secondSU2_struct_ij/jk/ki`: ⁅·hI,·hJ⁆=2·(·hK) cyclic). W8: `leftImDeriv_hK_ne_zero`, `secondSU2_hK_ne_zero`, `diagonal_not_commute_leftImDeriv` (⁅innerDeriv hI, leftImDeriv hJ⁆≠0 — the so(4) is a genuine selection, not all-commute degeneracy).

⭐⭐ CRITICAL CONTEXT — WHAT N195 BANKED. `Phys/Algebra/DerivationRep7IrreducibleAdjoint.lean` (namespace `Phys.Algebra`, 5 decls, gate D0–D6 expected GREEN, costume C227 `195 = -2`, foundations-only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). N194 irreducibilized the (2,2) = κO(⊤) (the new plane, dim 4) ONLY, on the LEFT-REGULAR module of H ℚ. N195 banks the SECOND summand's irreducibility — the OLD line ιO(ImH) (dim 3, the (3,1)) is IRREDUCIBLE under su(2)_S (the ADJOINT action), via the ADJOINT-rep Born-anisotropy lever (a DIFFERENT object + DIFFERENT lever than N194):
  • ⭐ `double_bracket_id` — for imaginary w,p: (4·quatNorm w)•p = adHom w (adHom p w) − (4·(w·p).re.re)•w (the adjoint/cross-product analogue of N194's starMulSelf_eq_quatNorm).
  • ⭐⭐ `iotaImH_irreducible` — a submodule W ⊆ ImH closed under all adHom Q (imaginary Q) is ⊥ or ImH (the adjoint ImH-rep has NO proper nonzero invariant; Born anisotropy quatNorm w ≠ 0 forces every imaginary p into W).
  • ⭐⭐ `iotaImH_su2S_irreducible` — the (3,1) = ιO(ImH) is su(2)_S-IRREDUCIBLE (transported through injective ιO + N193 secondSU2_iotaO).
  • W8: `iotaImH_ne_bot` + `imHLine_not_adjoint_invariant` (the line ℚ·hI is a PROPER NONZERO subspace that FAILS ad-invariance — adHom hJ hI = −2·hK leaves it — the dichotomy has teeth, not vacuous).

⚠⚠ THE STATE OF THE GAUGE STRUCTURE (W4.5 SUFFICIENCY — do NOT re-pin). Three SM factors banked individually (colour SU(3)⊂G₂=Der(O) dim 14 N42/N20, isospin SU(2)=Der(H) N184/N185, hypercharge U(1)=so(2) N186); inclusion tower u(1)↪su(2)↪g₂ COMPLETE (N187/N188); ALL THREE actions on the 7 banked (diagonal 1⊕3⊕3 N189/N190; su(2)_T 3·1⊕4 N192; su(2)_S + joint bigrading (3,1)⊕(2,2) N193); so(4)=su(2)_S×su(2)_T banked (N191); Der(O)⊆so(7) banked (N17/N18); BOTH branching summands IRREDUCIBLE under so(4) — the (2,2) (N194) and the (3,1) (N195) — a genuine FULLY IRREDUCIBLE so(4)-decomposition. ⚠ Do NOT re-pin any factor, do NOT re-state any rung, do NOT re-derive any branching, do NOT re-state the so(4)/so(7), do NOT re-prove EITHER summand's irreducibility. ⚠⚠ ELEVEN CONSECUTIVE gauge-structure nodes (N184–N195) — the W4.5 sufficiency bias is VERY STRONG: the gauge-representation arc is essentially complete. STRONGLY PREFER either a genuinely DIFFERENT physics joint OR an honest declaration that the gauge-rep arc is SUFFICIENTLY pinned and a pivot.

⭐ THE TARGET (N196). FIRST ACT (REQUIRED): RE-READ the ROADMAP §N195-superseded FORWARD FRONTIER paragraph and SPECIFY the exact node against what the chain ACTUALLY produced. ⚠⚠ ALWAYS grep/inspect what is ALREADY banked before picking a front (W4.5). The independent W1 fronts (MEASURE the smallest obligation of each BEFORE committing — W9 measure-first; ⚠⚠ look WIDE):
  (i) ⭐ THE FULL ISOTYPIC / SCHUR DECOMPOSITION — the two summands (3,1) and (2,2) are non-isomorphic (different su(2)_T-content: the (3,1) is su(2)_T-TRIVIAL, the (2,2) is the 4) ⟹ 7 = (3,1) ⊕ (2,2) is the UNIQUE isotypic decomposition (Schur). MEASURE opens-NEW (a genuine no-nonzero-intertwiner / Hom-space-between-summands argument, e.g. any so(4)-equivariant map (3,1)→(2,2) is zero) vs a mechanical juxtaposition of N194+N195 (reject if trivial, W8). ⚠ A real Schur statement needs the intertwiner-vanishing, NOT just "both irreducible".
  (ii) ⭐ THE so(4) ⊕ COMPLEMENT inside g₂=Der(O ℚ) (dim 14): the so(4) is 6-dim; does its commutant / the remaining 8 open structure? ⚠ MEASURE whether vacuous (reject, W8). ⚠ NOTE the type split: leftImDeriv/innerDeriv/secondSU2 live in `derivation` (N6, over ℤ, Module.End ℤ), N42's colour stabilizer in `derivationLieQ` (N20/N42, over ℚ, Module.End ℚ) — MEASURE whether a dimension/commutant statement needs a bridge (heavier).
  (iii) ⭐ hypercharge normalization / the electroweak U(1) embedding within the so(4) / a Yang–Mills structure / a genuinely DIFFERENT unbanked physics joint entirely (W4.5: look WIDEST — the gauge-rep arc is pinned).
  ⚠⚠ If a front measures as heavy/re-pin/vacuous/a juxtaposition/a mechanical consequence of N194 or N195 or banked irreducibility (N25/N28), look WIDER. Do NOT force a re-pin or restatement just to land a node (W4.5). A too-easy/vacuous/juxtaposition node is a BUG (W8). HONESTLY consider declaring the gauge-rep arc SUFFICIENTLY pinned and pivoting to a different physics joint entirely.

from N193: secondSU2_iotaO/secondSU2_kappaO/secondSU2_invariant_iotaImH/secondSU2_invariant_kappaTop/leftImDeriv_invariant_iotaImH/so4_pieces_invariant/secondSU2_singlet_eq_neg_leftImDeriv/diagonal_fixes_singlet_via_cancellation/secondSU2_singlet_coord/secondSU2_moves_singlet/secondSU2_acts_on_iotaImH_ne_zero; from N192: leftImDeriv_iotaO/leftImDeriv_kappaO/invariant_kappaTop/branchingT_sup_eq_ImO/finrank_kappaTop/branchingT_dim_sum/leftImDeriv_moves_singlet/leftImDeriv_annihilates_iotaImH/singlet_moved_coord; from N190: iotaO/iotaO_apply/iotaO_injective/kappaO_injective/innerDeriv_iotaO/innerDeriv_kappaO_full/starLH/ImH/mem_ImH/reH/reH_trace/finrank_ImH_eq_three/adHom_mem_ImH/invariant_iotaImH/invariant_kappaImH/fullBranching_sup_eq_ImO/finrank_iotaImH/finrank_kappaImH/finrank_singletLine/branching_dim_sum/action_on_iotaImH_ne_zero; from N6: adHom/innerDeriv/liftEnd/IsDeriv/derivation/innerDeriv_apply/adHom_apply/adHom_star_comm; from N22: ImO/imRep/mem_ImO/finrank_ImO; from N25: no_one_dim_invariant_ImO/IsDerivQ; from N28: ImLie/ImLie_isIrreducible). ⚠ A structure node likely needs `import Phys.Algebra.DerivationRep7IrreducibleAdjoint` (N195) + `DerivationRep7IrreducibleBimodule` (N194) + `DerivationRep7SU2SBranching` (N193) + `DerivationRep7SU2TBranching` (N192) + `DerivationRep7FullBranching` (N190) + `DerivationRep7` (N22) + the `attribute [local instance] CD.narCD CD.srCD` preamble. ⚠ D2 GATE: do NOT write the literal token "native_decide" anywhere (even in a comment); INFLATED maxHeartbeats / monolithic brute = W9 crime scene. ALSO CLEAN UP any scratch probe files left in Phys/ or the repo root (mv to workbench/, do NOT bulk-rm).

⚠ W8 — anti-vacuity. The new costume (next id C228) MUST bite a WRONG claim of the chosen front, reducing to a false numeric DISTINCT from the banked battery (… C225 193=-1, C226 194=1, C227 195=-2 — use a DISTINCT value, e.g. some_value=196). PASS_SIGNATURE is an ERE — use `.` for special chars, escape `*` as `.*`, avoid a leading `-`. ⚠ ANTI-VACUITY ESPECIALLY for a STRUCTURE/CONNECTION node: the relation must be NON-trivial — a map identically zero / an inclusion that is vacuous / a commutant that is the whole algebra (or trivially zero) / a decomposition that re-states a banked one / a mechanical consequence of N194/N195 or g₂-irreducibility (N25/N28) / a structure that follows trivially from base associativity / a "juxtaposition" that proves nothing new must be REJECTED (W8 + W4.5). Physics-words-removable: delete every physics word (colour/isospin/hypercharge/SM/gauge/SU(3)/SU(2)/U(1)/so(4)/electroweak/singlet/adjoint/branching/bigrading/bimodule/rep/commutant/diagonal/irreducible/isotypic/Schur) → the statement must stand as pure math about the banked objects + the derived ℚ/ℝ Cut + the Cayley–Dickson tower Dbl ℚ ⊂ H ℚ ⊂ O ℚ + the derivation algebra + the inner-derivation engine adHom/innerDeriv/liftEnd (N6) + the second-slot/difference families leftImDeriv/secondSU2 (N191) + the three actions on the 7 (N189/N190 diagonal, N192 su(2)_T, N193 su(2)_S + joint bigrading) + BOTH summand-irreducibilities / Born-anisotropy levers (N194 quatNorm/leftRegular_H_irreducible, N195 double_bracket_id/iotaImH_irreducible) + the inclusion tower (N187/N188) + the Lie bracket.

⭐ DISCIPLINE. PREREG workbench/N196-.../ (frozen GO/NO-GO + KILL before compute). Scratch lean isolated (cp into a temp file, `lake env lean` — note: `lake env lean` does NOT emit an olean, so to axiom-audit either build the module via `lake build <Module>` OR append `#print axioms` lines to the probe and read stdout; MOVE probes out of Phys/ AND the repo root before finalizing — mv to workbench/, do NOT bulk-rm). Production lean in Phys/ (zero axioms; VERIFY #print axioms ⊆ {propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound} yourself against the built olean + register in Audits/AxiomAudit.lean WITH ITS IMPORT AND add to Phys.lean). Costume = ONE ROW in scripts/costume_manifest.tsv (next id C228), TAB-separated (BID<TAB>file<TAB>signature). Gate scripts/gate.sh (bg). STANDARD check (unbroken/complete/words-removable). Commit + LEDGER row + ROADMAP (N196 LANDED or DECOMPOSED, specify the NEXT node). Gate-green NECESSARY≠SUFFICIENT.

DONE = the chosen N196 front PROVED — DERIVED from the chain (the banked N49–N195 + the derived ℚ/ℝ Cut + the Cayley–Dickson tower + the three gauge-algebra factors + the COMPLETE inclusion tower u(1)↪su(2)↪g₂ N187/N188 + ALL THREE actions on the 7 N189/N190 (diagonal) + N192 (su(2)_T) + N193 (su(2)_S + joint bigrading) + BOTH summand-irreducibilities / Born-anisotropy levers N194 (the (2,2)) + N195 (the (3,1)) + the so(4)=su(2)×su(2) N191 + the inner-derivation engine adHom/innerDeriv/liftEnd N6 + the g₂-irreducibility levers N22/N25/N28), gate D0–D6 green, costume C228 bites a WRONG claim, foundations-only, NON-VACUOUS (a genuine relation/structure, not a juxtaposition or re-pin or mechanical consequence or trivial associativity consequence), committed + LEDGER + ROADMAP updated, STANDARD applied; the NEXT node childed onto the chain tail. OR a DECOMPOSITION (bank the bankable structural piece now; child the remainder). OR an honest W1 dissolution ticket + block if the chosen front resists after measure + reframe. OR an HONEST PIVOT (declare the gauge-rep arc sufficiently pinned, specify and child a genuinely DIFFERENT physics joint). NO posited su(2)/so(3)/so(4)/su(3)/u(1)/SU(2)/SU(3)/U(1)/Lie group/division-ring as content, NO Mathlib ℝ/ℂ as content, NO bridge.

NOTE on max_retries: this node should carry max_retries=25 (the hard analytic/proof nodes routinely need 5–15 runs via bank-as-you-go; the default breaker trips at the 2nd timeout). If the creating tool could not set it, the operator should set it on the board.

THE CUBIC NORM (the Freudenthal reduced determinant) on J₃(O), and the WELL-DEFINEDNESS of its trilinear cross-term. Banked:

  • `jN_diag` (d0 d1 d2) : jN d0 d1 d2 0 0 0 = d0*d1*d2 — the product of the three real eigenvalues.
  • `jN_one` : jN 1 1 1 0 0 0 = 1 — unit norm of the identity.
  • `jN_frame0` : jN 1 0 0 0 0 0 = 0 — a primitive frame idempotent is rank 1.
  • ⭐⭐⭐ `jN_cross_assoc` (a b c) : reQ ((a*c)*star b) = reQ (a*(c*star b)) — the trilinear cross-term is BRACKETING-INDEPENDENT (via reQ_mul_assoc3 N210).
  • ⭐⭐⭐ `jN_cross_cyclic1` (a b c) : reQ ((a*c)*star b) = reQ ((c*star b)*a); `jN_cross_cyclic2` (a b c) : reQ ((a*c)*star b) = reQ ((star b*a)*c) — fully CYCLIC in the three octonion factors (via reQ_mul_assoc3 + reQ_mul_comm). THE WELL-DEFINEDNESS HEADLINE.
  • W8 teeth: `jN_witness_a` : jN 2 2 2 1 0 0 = 6; `jN_witness_cross` : jN 0 0 0 1 1 1 = 2; `jN_witness_cross_ne` : jN 0 0 0 1 1 1 ≠ 0.
